title: Office & Commercial Movers in Santa Clarita | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Office movers in Santa Clarita, CA for Valencia and Centre Pointe business parks: landlord COI, phased weekend moves, freeway ramp closures checked ahead.
heroTitle: Office & Commercial Movers in Santa Clarita
heroSubtitle: Offices, warehouse bays and medical suites across the Santa Clarita Valley, moved in phases that fit your lease dates and your team's workweek

faq.question: Do we need a city permit for the moving truck at our Santa Clarita office?
faq.answer: Not when the truck loads on private property. The city's encroachment permit covers anything placed in the public right-of-way, meaning the street, the curb lane or the sidewalk, so we plan loading from the building's own lot, truck court or dock whenever the property allows it. If a container or dumpster for the old suite has to sit on a city street, that permit is applied for at the City Permit Center, 23920 Valencia Blvd, Suite 140.

faq.question: Can the move happen over a weekend so the office doesn't close?
faq.answer: Yes. Crews work Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM, so departments can move on Saturday and Sunday in planned phases, each one finished within the day. If contractors are still fitting out a suite near homes, the city limits their work to weekday and Saturday windows, which leaves Sunday clear for the move-in.

faq.question: How is a commercial move in Santa Clarita priced?
faq.answer: By the hour for the crew and truck, with the rate set by the number of movers and the day of the week, starting at $119 cash for two movers Monday through Thursday. There is a 3-hour minimum, which grows to four hours once the address sits at least 30 miles out from our base, and drive time between addresses more than 10 miles apart is doubled. The crew size and number of trucks come out of the walkthrough, and the COI adds $50.

faq.question: Will the I-5 construction slow our move down?
faq.answer: It can change the route, not the plan. Metro and Caltrans are rebuilding the stretch of I-5 from SR-14 up to Parker Road, with ramp closures at interchanges such as McBean Parkway and Valencia Boulevard while the work lasts. We check the closure notices the evening before and choose an open approach, because drive time is part of the hourly bill.

faq.question: Do you move warehouse and industrial units as well as offices?
faq.answer: Yes. Parks such as Valencia Commerce Center mix industrial, office and retail buildings, and the crew handles racking, pallets and heavy shop equipment with lift gates and machine dollies. Any single piece above 300 lbs brings a $150 surcharge and a three-person crew, so list those pieces before the walkthrough.
